author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: #ProjectHailMary’s #Rocky can make anything, but it’s one thing to say that in a print and another to visually demonstrate it in a film. On set in 2024, art director Tim Browning explains to #AdamSavage how the look and logic of Rocky’s special skill were developed. Do you think it works?
title: How Rocky's Models Were Made for #ProjectHail#Mary

description:
Did ILM have a system for sorting and storing model parts for kit bashing? Why did Adam Savage look so concerned during the filming of the MythBusters supersonic ping pong episode? Is there any MythBusters project that may be outdated today given current knowledge? Why did Adam put the Coke bottle on the lathe? Does Adam have any favorite cheats from any of the props he built at ILM? What are some of Adam's favorite world building details from film and TV? In this live stream excerpt, Adam answers these questions from Tested members joshuaschisser2967, mattonthemoon, ChaosGenerator, wastelandreaper, the_gr8_brandino and thir13enthman, whom we thank for their support!
